title: E-FRC-0072: the Ward identity of the lattice Maxwell operator measured exactly: a pure-gauge gradient field is...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0072 in the gauge arena: the Ward identity of the lattice Maxwell operator measured exactly: a pure-gauge gradient field is annihilated to machine precision and the zero-mode count equals sites plus two (the gradients plus the three torus Wilson lines) at two lattice sizes, while a Proca mass returns the gradient times m squared and empties the zero-mode space, and a transverse field is not annihilated.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
